You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. The role Paid acquisition is one of the biggest levers we have on growth, and it's about to get a lot bigger. We run Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta today, we're adding new formats and channels, and over the next year we'll be running paid across more markets and across both sides of Dex: the engineers who use it and the companies who hire through it. You'll own our paid channels day to day. You'll decide where the money goes, launch and test campaigns quickly, and judge every channel on the quality of the people it brings in, not on clicks or cheap signups. Creative comes from our in-house creative lead, writers and UGC creators; your job is to brief them well, test what they make and scale what works. This isn't a role where you sit in the ad accounts all week. Once the channels are running well, we want you to take on more: client-side acquisition, new channels, and building your own tools with AI to do the job faster. What you'll do Own Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta: structure, budgets, bidding, audiences and day-to-day optimisation. Launch new campaigns in days, not weeks. Run a steady programme of tests across audiences, formats and landing pages. Judge channels on what matters to Dex: good candidates and the ones who get put forward to clients. Work with our data to make sure conversion tracking and attribution are right, and push quality signals back into the platforms. Brief creative. Work with our creative lead, writers and UGC creators on what to make, tell them what's working and kill what isn't. Open up new channels as we grow, such as YouTube, Performance Max, retargeting and new markets. Help take paid into client acquisition: getting Dex in front of heads of talent, engineering leaders and founders. Manage our paid media agency and any contractors, and bring more of the work in-house over time. Report clearly on spend and results each week, and say plainly what you'd change. Who we're looking for Hands on in performance marketing, managing real budgets yourself across paid search and paid social. Meta and LinkedIn experience matters most. You've worked at a tech company, or you're ready for your first in-house role after a couple of years at a strong agency. You care about what happens after the click. You've optimised for downstream quality, not just cost per lead, and you know how to set up tracking that you trust. Comfortable with data. You can pull your own numbers, spot when something looks wrong, and explain what's going on without a dashboard doing it for you. You move fast and like owning things. You'd rather ship a test today than plan it for a week. You use AI tools daily, and you're happy building small tools, scripts or agents to do your job better. You don't need to be an engineer. Strong nice-to-haves You've run performance marketing for both consumer (B2C) and business (B2B) audiences, ideally at more than one tech company. You've worked closely with a creative studio or run UGC at volume, so you know what a good brief looks like. If you don't tick every box but this sounds like you, apply anyway. Why join now You'll own a channel mix that's growing fast, with the budget and freedom to try things. You'll work on a product people care about. Changing jobs is one of the biggest decisions engineers make, and we want them to trust us with it. You'll work closely with the founders and the Head of Growth, with a lot of room to grow your scope. Everyone here builds with AI. You'll have the tools and the time to work that way. description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. About the job Are you someone with a passion for DevOps and are looking to help build and be part of a new Developer Experience team within the Motorway Product & Engineering org? Motorway continues to grow, and we want to provide our developers with the best experience, which is where you come in. We have recently built and rolled out a new container platform on top of AWS Fargate, and are currently enhancing our observability, reliability, and developer-focused tooling. We will continue to build and evolve secure, standardised platform capabilities that reduce cognitive load and help teams ship faster with confidence. This is an exciting time to join, the team is new and the company growing which presents opportunities to do things “right” to set up success for the org into the future. What you'll do Own and evolve our AWS environments and shared platform infrastructure, focusing on reliability, scalability, and ease of use for product teams. Design and build opinionated, self-service tooling that makes it easy for engineers to build, deploy, and operate services correctly. Continuously reduce manual work (toil) by automating common workflows and standardising infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and platform abstractions. Define and implement platform-level monitoring and alerting standards that provide meaningful signals without overwhelming teams. Enable product teams to use shared metrics and signals to understand and improve the reliability of their services across environments. Own and evolve our continuous delivery and release capabilities, reducing time to production while maintaining high standards of reliability and safety. Stay current with best practices in application hosting, continuous delivery, and developer experience, and apply them pragmatically to the platform. Upskill and mentor other engineers in the team. As a senior engineer, you are expected to bring prior experience operating and evolving production platforms at scale. You’ll use your judgement to make trade-offs, anticipate failure modes, and help the team avoid repeating past mistakes. Learning is encouraged and supported, but you should be comfortable operating independently after onboarding and sharing lessons from real-world experience. Requirements Proven track record of owning and operating web platforms in production at scale. Strong experience with AWS in a production environment. Experience defining meaningful metrics, monitoring, and alerting for web platforms, with a strong intuition for actionable vs noisy signals. Experience working with platform-level security controls and observability, including identifying and responding to abnormal or unsafe system behaviour. Experience designing and operating continuous delivery systems that support safe, repeatable, zero-downtime deployments. Experience responding to production incidents in an on-call environment and improving systems based on what you learn. Comfortable with command-line tools and environments. Proficient with at least one programming language used for automation or tooling. Enjoy solving complex, cross-cutting problems in collaboration with engineers across the organisation Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements and priorities. Enjoy mentoring and sharing knowledge within the team and the wider engineering organisation. This role includes a shared, out-of-hours on-call rotation after an initial onboarding period. title: Account Executive
description: Account Executive EU GTM | London, United Kingdom About the team Join our high-energy team in London and help us bring smarter payment solutions to growing businesses across the UK and Europe. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower merchants by making payments simple, accessible, and hassle-free. Today, we support over 4 million businesses in 30+ countries — and we're just getting started. As an Account Executive, you'll be part of a collaborative, fast-paced team driving growth and helping business owners with £50k+ in revenue access the tools they need to succeed. What you'll do Proactively identify and reach out to prospects via calls, emails, and social — you'll be the one starting the conversation Build strong relationships by understanding the unique needs of each business and showing how SumUp can make a real difference Go on-site to meet prospects and clients in person — building trust face-to-face and delivering demos that convert Deliver value-driven product pitches and demos that help convert curiosity into commitment Own the full sales cycle — from first outreach to deal closed Track your performance, meet your goals, and continuously level up through feedback and data Share insights, collaborate with your team, and help build an energised outbound culture in the office You'll be great for this role if… You have 1–2 years of outbound sales or business development experience — and a drive to learn and grow fast in the role. You're confident, curious, and comfortable with high-volume outreach (mostly phone-based). You love solving problems and helping people. You're results-driven and thrive on smashing targets. You bring a positive, team-first attitude and enjoy celebrating wins with your colleagues. Bonus: Experience in payment tech, SaaS, or hospitality tools is a big plus. Why you should join SumUp 💸 Competitive base salary + uncapped commission — your earning potential grows with your success! ✅ A foot in the fintech door — work for a global brand that's scaling fast and be part of a mission-driven team with real impact 🏢 Office-first culture in Central London — collaborate face-to-face with a fun, supportive team and stay connected to the energy of live sales 📚 €2,000 annual learning budget — invest in your development with training, events, or courses that support your goals 🧘 Sabbatical after 3 years — take a well-earned 30-day break to reset or pursue something meaningful 🌍 Diverse and inclusive workplace — be part of a team that values different perspectives and creates space for everyone to thrive 🔗 Referral bonus — help grow the team by referring talented friends or former colleagues and get rewarded for it About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp. title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role. Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet. Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction. Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform. Your Profile: 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup. A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit. Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features. Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring. Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them. Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level. Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders. A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus. Fluent English required Our hiring process : TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster. We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English. *Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role. #LI-PM1 At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment. Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner. The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - UK&I
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in the UKI. You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>Experience Without Limits</strong><br><strong>Come shape the future of brand experience.</strong></h3> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>At Jack Morton, we design and build<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong>head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><strong>unlock the full value of experiences</strong> by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one.</strong> We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">This is a place where curiosity drives what’s next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.</p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.</p></div><p>The Account Executive will support the assigned Account Management team and a portfolio of clients. title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
description: <p><strong>Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement</strong></p> <p><em>Location: Remote</em> — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.</p> <p><strong>The Role </strong></p> <p>The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.</p> <p><strong>Top Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Measurement & Data Strategy</strong></p> <p>• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.</p> <p>• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.</p> <p>• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.</p> <p>• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.</p> <p>• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving</strong></p> <p>• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.</p> <p>• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.</p> <p>• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.</p> <p>• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.</p> <p><strong>Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.</strong></p> <p>• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p>• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.</p> <p>• Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.</p> <p><strong>Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership</strong></p> <p>• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.</p> <p>• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.</p> <p>• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.</p> <p>• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like:</strong></p> <p><strong>By 6 Months</strong></p> <p>The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.</p> <p><strong>By 1 Year</strong></p> <p>The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.</p> <p><strong>Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <p>• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity</p> <p>• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences</p> <p>• Commercially minded</p> <p>• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels</p> <p>• Naturally curious and innovative</p> <p>• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader</p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications & Skills:</strong></p> <p>• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy</p> <p>• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams</p> <p>• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing</p> <p>• Experience leading teams and developing talent</p> <p>• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing</p> <p>• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)</p> <p>• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics</p> <p>• SQL and data querying experience preferred</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?</strong></p> <p>Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.</p> <p><strong>AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>100% remote work for everyone </li> <li>Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) </li> <li>401K with matching </li> <li>Open Paid Time Off </li> <li>Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December </li> <li>Volunteer and Birthday Time Off </li> <li>Focus Fridays </li> <li>Paid Parental Leave Benefits </li> <li>Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances </li> <li>Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! </li> <li>Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience.</li> </ul> <p>Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.</em></p> <p>  </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE  </p> <p><em>*GLSDR</em> </p> <p>#LI-MG1 </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Services Architect 3 - Paris/London
description: <p>Datadog’s Implementation Services team helps customers implement and deploy Datadog quickly. Our team of architects leads the discovery, design, build, and launch of the Datadog platform to help customers accelerate time to value and get the most out of their investment. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for developing the technical roadmap for a customer’s implementation, and leading them through it every step of the way.   </p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p>What You’ll Do:</p> <ul> <li>Design and guide execution of Datadog implementations, including gathering requirements, building technical architecture, and supporting deployment and launch</li> <li>Guide customer onboarding through co-development working sessions and assist when they run into roadblocks</li> <li>Write automation and design architecture for deployment templates </li> <li>Manage the operation of implementation projects </li> <li>Collaborate with other teams, including Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Sales to deliver an exceptional onboarding experience</li> </ul> <p>Who You Are:</p> <ul> <li>Experience designing and delivering technical solutions for DevOps Monitoring or architecture systems</li> <li>Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and compute technologies (EC2, serverless, VMware, VMs, Docker, Kubernetes).</li> <li>Experience with Config Management, IAC and CI/CD tools, including Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, Chef, Jenkins, Circle CI, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, etc…</li> <li>Experience programming/scripting with any of the following: Java, Python, Ruby, Go, Node.JS, PHP, and .NET etc</li> <li>Successful track record with 5+ years experience as an Architect or Consultant in a professional services team</li> <li>Able to sit up to 4 hours, traveling to and from client sites </li> <li>Able to travel via auto, train or air up to 30% of the time</li> <li>Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.</em></p> <p>Benefits and Growth:</p> <ul> <li>Best-in-breed onboarding</li> <li>Generous global benefits</li> <li>Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog: </strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
description: <h4><strong>About the job</strong></h4> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware.<br>Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack.<br><br>You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need.<br><br>You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements.</p> <h4><strong>The team and culture</strong></h4> <p>The AI Compute Libraries team develops high-performance compute libraries and the software infrastructure that helps engineers make effective use of Graphcore’s AI hardware.</p> <p>You’ll work alongside specialists in accelerator software, runtime systems and performance engineering. Together, you’ll turn hardware capabilities and developer requirements into practical, well-tested APIs, with clear documentation and dependable releases.</p> <h4><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></h4> <h4>Essential skills:</h4> <ul> <li>Strong modern C++ skills and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable code.</li> <li>The ability to turn complex, low-level concepts into clear APIs and abstractions.</li> <li>Strong debugging and automated testing skills, including diagnosing issues in existing codebases.</li> <li>Confidence owning substantial engineering tasks independently and working effectively across teams.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication, with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with hardware accelerators, heterogeneous computing or architecture-specific software.</li> <li>Experience with embedded DSLs, graph representations, descriptor generation or compiler infrastructure.</li> <li>Familiarity with CMake, C++ library packaging, API/ABI compatibility, versioning or dependency management.</li> <li>Experience integrating C++ libraries with Python or ML frameworks such as PyTorch.</li> <li>Experience improving release automation, compatibility testing or developer tooling.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Benefits</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong> Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong> Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong> Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace experience:</strong> Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong> Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li><strong>Electric Vehicle Scheme:</strong> Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong> Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br><br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><br><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.<br><br></p> <h4><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></h4> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.<br><br>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.<br><br>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.<br><br>Ready to shape the libraries developers use to build and run accelerator workloads? Apply to join Graphcore’s AI Compute Libraries team in Bristol.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">evaluation</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">trials</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">capabilities</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and internally developed solutions into deployable systems.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The lab </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">supportable</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and resilient.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW239653401 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities. </p> <p>The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis. </p> <p>The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support. </p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials. </p> <p>The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln. </p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><span Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Fans have opinions. Fanatics Markets lets them trade on them.</p> <p>Fanatics connects 100M+ fans with around 900 sports partners across Commerce, Collectibles, and Betting & Gaming. We’re now building Fanatics Markets, and we want it to be the biggest and best prediction market for sports, sports culture, crypto and beyond.</p> <p>Our core customer is a sports-first trader who is more likely to use Robinhood or Hyperliquid than a sportsbook. We’re building a suite of tools to give this customer the best possible trading experience from their phone. We have a small, high-performing team and a very flat structure to ensure the best ideas win.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager who is highly nimble and can solve a wide range of problems across the entire product stack. You’ll come in, understand the problem, define a solution, ship, iterate and move on to the next problem. Here are some example problems you might solve:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Building the best perpetual futures product for a sports-first trader</p> </li> <li> <p>Building a “pro” trading mode for our best customers</p> </li> <li> <p>Building industry-first tools that help traders make better decisions</p> </li> <li> <p>Building new types of rewards and incentives for traders</p> </li> <li> <p>Whatever else you come up with to drive trading volume and grow the business</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll need</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>2–6 years’ experience in Product Management</p> </li> <li> <p>A love of numbers – you think in probabilities and make data-driven decisions</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communication skills, both written and verbal</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience delivering amazing products to end customers</p> </li> <li> <p>An entrepreneurial, high-ownership mindset</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort with basic trading concepts and familiar with top platforms like Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and Hyperliquid.</p> </li> <li> <p>You move fast</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience in fintech  or building a trading product</p> </li> <li> <p>A STEM background or quantitative degree<br><br>#LI-LS2<br><br></p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. title: Technical Account Manager
description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. 🚀 The Adventure Ahead As a Technical Account Manager, you’re the trusted technical engine behind our enterprise customers' greatest learning transformations! You will embed yourself as an essential strategic partner, bridging high-level customer business goals with Docebo’s cutting-edge platform capabilities. In this role, you won't just solve problems—you'll architect long-term technical strategies, pilot innovative solutions, and ensure our customers unlock maximum value to become partners for life. ⚡ The Day-to-Day Architect the Future: Translate customer business and eLearning goals into long-term, scalable technical strategies using Docebo’s robust feature set. Own the Technical Relationship: Take full technical and product ownership of your assigned enterprise accounts while collaborating closely with Account Teams on commercial growth. Serve as the Trusted Advisor: Guide executive and technical stakeholders through platform innovations, API integrations, and AI-assisted workflows to maximize operational efficiency. Proactively Protect Platform Health: Monitor technical performance metrics—like API usage and login trends—to catch and mitigate potential risks long before they hit platform stability. Lead Executive Technical Reviews: Deliver high-impact performance presentations on SLAs directly to customer leadership and champion customer feedback internally to Docebo teams. Drive Systemic Platform Improvements: Partner with Premium Advisors and internal resources to analyze support case patterns, run proof-of-concept pilot projects, and streamline overall platform health. 💪 Your Superpowers Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Bring 5+ years of SaaS technical troubleshooting and 2+ years of enterprise/large account management experience. Integration & Auth Mastery: Hold a solid foundation in back-end practices, RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and front-end essentials like JavaScript, CSS, and HTML. Data & Middleware Savvy: Possess hands-on skills in at least two key areas: iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier), SQL queries, or data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI). Executive Translator: Master the art of taking complex, highly technical concepts and translating them into simple, high-value business conversations for executive decision-makers. Global Flexibility & Travel: Ready to support EMEA regional time zones and comfortable traveling internationally up to 25% of the time. Project Management Mindset: Bring proactive ownership, analytical decision-making, and experience forecasting product release impacts or advising on AI/automation integrations. 🌟 Bonus Points Cloud Certified: Possess an active AWS Product Certification. Domain Experience: Background in the e-Learning, Learning Management (LMS), or Human Capital Management (HCM) industries. Scalability Specialist: Direct experience consulting on platform performance, high availability, uptime, and enterprise scalability. Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝 Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing. Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. Our Promise to You 😍 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! Family First : We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long. About Docebo 💙 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs ( TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO ), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection —that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer . title: Field Marketing Manager
description: The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work , sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that. Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years . We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI. We’re at an inflection point: We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI. We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market . We’re just getting started. What you'll be doing Own how Ankar shows up in the market - where we show up, what we do, and how we turn those moments into commercial outcomes. You’ll work closely with Sales and Commercial Development to build field programmes that create and accelerate pipeline. Own Field Marketing end-to-end. Lead everything from industry conferences and webinars to executive dinners, roundtables and targeted experiences. Build programmes around commercial priorities. Understand target accounts, active opportunities and pipeline gaps, and design programmes that create and accelerate demand. Partner deeply with Sales. Drive target account selection, outreach, meeting generation and fast follow-up around every programme. Build account-based experiences. Bring together events, gifting, direct outreach, digital and content to engage strategic accounts. Execute brilliantly. Own logistics, vendors, speakers, stakeholders and timelines across multiple programmes. Measure what matters. Track impact through account engagement, opportunities, deal progression, pipeline and revenue. Qualifications 3+ years of experience in B2B field marketing , owning and executing programmes from events and webinars to targeted account-based experiences. Strong experience partnering with Sales to support target accounts, create pipeline and accelerate active opportunities. Highly autonomous and comfortable managing multiple programmes, stakeholders, vendors and deadlines end-to-end. Creative and commercially minded, with a strong bias towards action and measurable commercial outcomes. Excellent communicator, able to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, leadership and external partners. This role is not for you if... You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction. You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information. You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products. You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one. What we put behind our people Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly. Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents. Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings. Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office. Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free. Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from. title: Marketing Lead
description: Who We Are: At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes all while raising money for the causes they love. Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work. And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale. 🔑 About The Job Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen. Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth. This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time. You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution. 🔧 What You’ll Be Doing Build the go-to-market strategy Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale. Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation. Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set. Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time. Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition. Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth. Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs. Lead every campaign Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch. Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief. Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives. Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time. Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market. Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy. Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation. Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact. Build the playbook Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently. Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate. Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys. Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data. Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type. Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time. Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap. 🤩 About You We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions. You'll probably have: Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles. Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth. Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data. A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth. Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies. Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals.. The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines. Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists. Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist. The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done. 🙌 What’s In It For You Generous stock options scheme 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays Private medical and dental insurance 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2% A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships Enhanced family leave policies Life assurance of 4x your salary DEI Statement We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.
